title: RE harness run report (v1)
description: One JSON document per run, archived under docs/re/harness-runs/. Small and deterministic: no timestamps, no absolute paths, keys sorted. Gate reports (self-parity, xyflow-examples, selftest) carry oracle=real with the oracle library version read from its package.json; synthetic reports carry oracle=synthetic and never count for a gate. covered is reserved for green candidate-against-reference verdicts; self-parity verdicts never count as covered (SPEC_RE_BPMN_JS_PARITY §8.1).

oracle.description: real = produced by the pinned library itself; synthetic = produced by synthetic-engines.mjs (never a gate).

oracleVersions.description: Versions read from the oracle packages' own package.json files.
